root_cause.text: rtl92cu_tx_fill_desc() in the rtlwifi 8192cu TX path used the TID returned by ieee80211_get_tid(hdr) directly as an index into sta_entry->tids[] without validating it against MAX_TID_COUNT, causing an out-of-bounds array access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `agg_state = sta_entry->tids[tid].agg.agg_state;` to only execute under `if (tid < MAX_TID_COUNT)`, and the CVE/commit explicitly states that `ieee80211_get_tid()` may return a value out of range for `sta_entry->tids[]`, with UBSAN reporting `index 10 is out of range for type 'rtl_tid_data [9]'`.

intent_record.what: The code now wraps the access to sta_entry->tids[tid].agg.agg_state in a conditional check, so agg_state is assigned only if tid is less than MAX_TID_COUNT.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this prevents indexing the tids array with an out-of-range tid value, avoiding invalid memory access and leaving agg_state unchanged when tid is outside the valid TID range.
